scene: A barren grey dusty cratered plain under a pitch-black sky, showing the surface of the Moon, as seen in frame 200 where grey soil, black sky, two suited figures and a planted flag are all visible.
things: two people in bulky white spacesuits with large white life-support backpacks, helmets and gloves
a United States flag with stars and stripes on a thin vertical pole planted in the ground
grey cratered soil with footprints and small depressions
pitch-black sky background with no clouds
long dark shadows on the ground
what_happens: At 0.0s a suited astronaut with a backpack stands in the left foreground with back to camera while a second suited astronaut stands near a flag on a pole in the mid-background on grey ground under black sky.
At 5.0s the foreground astronaut turns sideways and moves across the ground in small steps and hops with an arm extended while the background astronaut stays near the flag.
At 8.5s the foreground astronaut crouches then leaps upward with both feet off the ground, lands, and leaps again with a prolonged airborne phase while the background astronaut watches near the flag.
At 15.0s both astronauts walk toward the right past the flagpole, with long shadows cast across the grey dusty ground.
